diagram_title: Fail Loud On Invisible Readiness Path

activities.title: Guard Root Visibility
activities.description: readiness_common.root_guard(folder): the single chokepoint. Returns (root, visible, warning). visible = Path(folder).exists(); warning is the boundary string when not visible. Pure, read-only, no fallback. boundary_next_step(path) builds the mount-or-file-model instruction.

activities.title: Ingest With Explicit Root State
activities.description: project_ingest.ingest_project_folder: on not base.exists() set root_exists=False (distinct from scanned-but-empty: root_exists=True, files==[]) and append the 'not visible' warning; surface both via ProjectFolderIndex.to_dict().

activities.title: Assess Package Readiness
activities.description: assess_package_readiness calls root_guard first; on invisible root returns early a PackageReadiness with root_visible=False, warnings, boundary next_step, readiness_pct=0 — never scoring deliverables as missing. Visible root path is unchanged.

activities.title: Assess Per-Stage Readiness
activities.description: c00/c01/c02/c04/c05/c06 readiness fns call root_guard first; invisible root returns a distinct status='path-not-visible' + root_visible=False + warning. c00 keeps raising C00TemplateError when answer_state.json is missing inside a VISIBLE folder (separate loud signal).

activities.title: Surface Boundary To Output And Docs
activities.description: Every readiness to_dict() emits root_visible + warnings (additive superset). render_readiness_markdown shows a 'folder not visible' banner. MCP server INSTRUCTIONS qualify host-path-must-be-mounted + file-model + big-tree exclude guidance; skill references/container-boundary.md + SKILL.md pointer sediment the boundary.
